correctness.rationale: For n>=4, harmonicity of the three-step Laplacian forces each vertex to fire k=1 or k=2 times in a primitive-three orbit. For k=1, phase colors c(v) give predecessor counts q_v>=1 and exactly q_v independent integer chip offsets; the complement x_v -> 2d_v-1-x_v produces k=2 and mass reversal about 7n-1. The exact phase-offset mass formula 2n+m(c)+sum s_v establishes bands and every intervening mass. The nine-state transfer determinant det(I-tM(y))=1-t-2yt^2-(y^2+4y)t^3-2y^2t^4-y^2t^5+y^2t^6 yields H_n(1)=3n(F_{2n+1}+delta_n); the support matrix characteristic polynomial gives both inner coefficients. Direct independent whole-state enumeration and the polynomial/firing-phase crosschecks support n=4,5; this finite verification is not substituted for the all-n transfer and coloring proof. The claimed n>=4, nonnegative chips, labelled rim, immediate least period 3 and gap normalization are consistent.

This is not mere direct restatement of general periodicity existence.
